en.title: Borodin: String Quartet No. 2, I. Allegro moderato – Listening Guide
en.overview: This movement opens with a calm tune in the cello. That tune comes back many times, in different instruments and different keys. The key and chord labels in this guide are estimated by computer, so treat them as a guide and not as fact. Listen for the opening tune, for the changes between soft and loud, and for the return of the opening in the last big section.

listening_points.headline: The cello sings the main tune
listening_points.text: The cello plays the main tune softly in D major [m. 1-3]. Keep this shape in your ear, because it returns often.

listening_points.headline: First violin takes the tune, in a darker key
listening_points.text: The mood darkens as the key moves to B minor [m. 4-13]. The first violin takes the tune [m. 5-7]. Crescendo marks appear in places, so the music swells [m. 8]. The key is back in D major at [m. 14].

listening_points.headline: Cello again, then a build-up to mezzo-forte
listening_points.text: The cello brings the tune back in D major [m. 16-18]. The first violin takes it up [m. 20-22]. A crescendo then leads to mezzo-forte (medium loud) at [m. 28].

listening_points.headline: The cello tune swells and falls back
listening_points.text: The cello plays the tune twice more [m. 35-37] and [m. 39-41]. Crescendo marks appear in both. Soft playing returns at [m. 39].

listening_points.headline: Wandering keys and a sudden loud burst
listening_points.text: The estimated keys shift quickly here, through E major, F# minor and Db major [m. 45-55]. The volume jumps suddenly to loud (forte) at [m. 52]. Nobody clearly leads there, so the lead is shared. It is soft again at [m. 56].

listening_points.headline: Restless middle of the first part
listening_points.text: The key moves between A major and F# minor [m. 66-85]. The lead is often unclear, and at times the lines are independent [m. 73-76]. A quieter spell (mezzo-piano) begins at [m. 73].

listening_points.headline: Loud A major close, then silence
listening_points.text: The music turns loud in A major [m. 86-106]. The lead passes among several parts, and the analysis is unsure who is on top. All parts are silent (tacet) at [m. 107].

listening_points.headline: Section 2: the tune returns in A minor
listening_points.text: A new section begins, marked Tempo I. The cello plays the tune softly in A minor [m. 108-110]. The first violin then takes it in D minor [m. 112-114].

listening_points.headline: Moving through many keys
listening_points.text: The estimated keys change often here, including C major, F major and D major [m. 117-138]. The volume reaches loud at [m. 130]. Several parts play together in the same rhythm, which is called homophonic texture [m. 128-130].

listening_points.headline: A brighter glow, with the lead passed around
listening_points.text: The key brightens to B major [m. 143-151], then moves to Ab major [m. 152-157]. The lead passes between the viola, first violin and cello in short turns. It moves between soft and mezzo-forte (medium loud), with crescendo marks.

listening_points.headline: Lines tossed between the violins and viola
listening_points.text: All four lines move on their own for a long stretch [m. 159-173]. The lead passes quickly between the violins and viola. It stays soft. Then the key reaches A major [m. 175] and D major [m. 179].

listening_points.headline: Section 3: the opening comes home
listening_points.text: The cello plays the main tune at the original pitch in D major [m. 180-182]. This is a clear return of the opening. The first violin takes it in B minor [m. 184-186], as before. The cello and first violin repeat the tune at [m. 195] and [m. 199].

listening_points.headline: The tune drifts into C minor
listening_points.text: The cello plays the tune at [m. 214-216]. Then the viola and cello pass it back and forth in G minor and C minor [m. 216-222]. The volume rises to mezzo-forte at [m. 224]. The lead is uncertain in much of this stretch, so think of it as shared.

listening_points.headline: Build to the estimated loudest point
listening_points.text: The music moves through F major, D minor and E minor [m. 247-257]. Crescendo marks lead to loud at [m. 257]. A computer estimate marks measure 259 as the loudest point, in F# minor. The key then moves to B minor [m. 261].

listening_points.headline: Back in D major, fading to a quiet end
listening_points.text: D major returns loud at [m. 266]. Diminuendo marks then make the music softer [m. 272-285]. It is soft at [m. 286]. The cello plays solo at [m. 297-298]. The last bars are very soft, with the parts playing in unison or octaves [m. 303].

glossary.explanation: The home note and scale the music centres on. A change of key can brighten or darken the mood.
Loud (f) and soft (p). Mezzo-forte (mf) is medium loud. Pianissimo (pp) is very soft.
Each instrument plays its own melody at the same time, instead of one tune with a backing.
The instruments move together with the same rhythm, like a hymn.
The same note played at different heights by different instruments.
A measure where an instrument, or all of them, are silent.

zh.title: 鲍罗丁第二弦乐四重奏 第一乐章 听赏指南
zh.overview: 这是一个以 D 大调为主调的乐章，共 304 小节，分为三大段。开头由大提琴奏出主要主题，之后它多次回来。请留意主题由谁演奏、音量强弱和调性变化。调性和和声是软件估算的，可能有误。本指南着重大局，小细节可能不够精确。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴在弱音中奏出主要主题
listening_points.text: 乐章开始，大提琴在弱（p）的力度上奏出主要主题 [m. 1-3]。这是大提琴领奏、另外两件乐器参与的三声部织体。调性估算为 D 大调。请先记住这条旋律。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴在 B 小调接过主题
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴在 B 小调中奏出同一主题，比开头高 5 个半音 [m. 5-7]。此处各声部线条较为独立。调性比开头更暗一些。

listening_points.headline: 回到 D 大调，主题再度出现
listening_points.text: 大提琴在 D 大调中再次奏出主题，比开头低一个八度 [m. 16-18]。[m. 17-18] 是主调织体，即几个声部节奏基本一致。随后第一小提琴也在 D 大调接过主题 [m. 20-22]。

listening_points.headline: 渐强，力度升到中强
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴带着旋律，其他乐器伴奏 [m. 23-27]。这里标有渐强，声音逐渐变响。到 [m. 28] 力度成为中强（mf）。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴两次奏出低音主题
listening_points.text: 大提琴在 [m. 35-37] 和 [m. 39-41] 又两次奏出主题。两次都在 D 大调，都从弱（p）开始，并带有渐强标记。

listening_points.headline: 调性游走，音量突然变强
listening_points.text: 音乐转入 E 大调、F# 小调，再到 Db 大调 [m. 45-55]。到 [m. 52] 力度变为强（f）。此处领奏声部不明确，可以看作几个声部共同承担。

listening_points.headline: 回到弱音，在 F# 小调中徘徊
listening_points.text: [m. 56] 力度回到弱（p），调性回到 F# 小调。[m. 59] 起力度又升到中强（mf）。之后经过 A 大调、E 大调等，又回到 F# 小调 [m. 81]。此处谁领奏不太清楚，声部线条相互交织。

listening_points.headline: A 大调的强奏，然后安静下来
listening_points.text: [m. 86] 起音乐在 A 大调，力度为强（f），持续到 [m. 106]。第一部分在 [m. 107] 结束，这一小节所有乐器都休止。

listening_points.headline: 第二段：主题移到 A 小调与 D 小调
listening_points.text: 第二段回到原速。大提琴在 A 小调奏出主题 [m. 108-110]。第一小提琴随后在 D 小调接过 [m. 112-114]。色彩比开头更暗。

listening_points.headline: 调性不断转换，力度起伏
listening_points.text: 音乐经过 G 小调、C 大调、F 大调等 [m. 114-129]。起初力度为弱，到 [m. 120] 变为中强。[m. 130] 变强（f），到 [m. 132] 又回到中强。此处领奏声部常换，许多位置判断不太确定。

listening_points.headline: 明亮的 B 大调与 Ab 大调，旋律在声部间传递
listening_points.text: 调性来到 B 大调 [m. 143]，再到 Ab 大调 [m. 152]。旋律在中提琴、第一小提琴和大提琴之间轮流出现。其中还有渐强和渐弱的标记。

listening_points.headline: 各声部线条交错，走向 A 大调再回 D 大调
listening_points.text: [m. 159-173] 各声部线条较为独立，领奏轮流变换，力度为弱。之后经过 A 小调 [m. 166]、A 大调 [m. 175]，[m. 179] 回到 D 大调。这一段在为主题回归做准备。

listening_points.headline: 第三段：开头主题回归
listening_points.text: [m. 180] 大提琴在 D 大调奏出主题，音高与 [m. 1] 完全相同。随后第一小提琴在 B 小调 [m. 184-186] 和 D 大调 [m. 199-201] 接过主题。这一段与乐章开头很像。

listening_points.headline: 主题在声部间传递，转入 G 小调与 C 小调
listening_points.text: 大提琴在 [m. 214] 奏出主题，之后中提琴、大提琴、中提琴依次接力 [m. 216-222]。调性转入 G 小调和 C 小调，色彩变暗。力度仍为弱，到 [m. 224] 变为中强。

listening_points.headline: 分析标出的最响点在 F# 小调
listening_points.text: 调性经 E 小调、F# 小调推向 B 小调。从 [m. 257] 起力度为强（f）。分析软件把 [m. 259] 标为最响、最忙的点，这是电脑估算的结果。

listening_points.headline: D 大调的强奏，然后变弱
listening_points.text: [m. 266] 回到 D 大调，力度为强（f）。之后标有渐弱 [m. 272-283]。到 [m. 286] 力度变为弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 安静地结束，以很弱的齐奏收尾
listening_points.text: [m. 297-298] 是大提琴独奏。[m. 300-302] 是主调织体。[m. 303] 是齐奏或八度齐奏，力度很弱（pp）。最后一小节没有乐器演奏。

glossary.explanation: 乐曲中反复出现、容易记住的旋律。
乐曲的“中心音”和色彩。大调通常较明亮，小调通常较暗。
几个声部节奏基本一致，像一起唱和弦。
各声部奏同一条旋律，可以相隔八度。
f 表示强，p 表示弱，mf 表示中强；很弱是 pp。
